title: The Bacteria That Changed Medicine
short_teaser: Alexander Fleming returned from time away and noticed that mold had contaminated one of his bacterial cultures.
story: Alexander Fleming returned from time away and noticed that mold had contaminated one of his bacterial cultures. Around the mold, the bacteria had stopped growing. The observation eventually helped open the path to penicillin. The breakthrough began because an unwanted result was examined instead of immediately discarded. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: The breakthrough began because an unwanted result was examined instead of immediately discarded. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly.
spark_application: Write down one unexpected result or unanswered question from your own work. List three possible explanations before choosing one. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
